page.layout: One block of running text in a single column, with the running head above it and the page number at top right. Below the text, after a gap, one italic prayer passage. Signature and catchword at the foot. No marginal notes. Show-through from the other side of the leaf runs down the left edge and is left out.

main_text.p: ronæ meæ Honore & Salute Populi conjunctaꝫ queis sim uno forsan Verbo magis nociturus, quàm quæcunque Belli mala: dum, ut paucis indulgeatur, cunctos pessundem[?].
Revivifcent (Deo juvante) Leges noftræ, & cum iis Subditorum Meorum obsequium & amor, modò ne Meo Consensu sepeliantur eo Probri & Injustitiæ Tumulo, qui à nonnullorum violentia effoditur.
Si non aliàs hæc liceat redimere quàm Libertatis meæ aut Mortis pretio, en Me ultro paratum dependere.
Nulla fors Regi verè calamitosa, quæ secum Animæ Ipsius & Populi & Posterorum servitutem non trahit.

Cernent forsan futura sæcula in quod præsens ultrò amat cæcutire: & ostendet Deus aliquando Populo meo, Me pro Illis potiùs optâsse, quàm cum Illis pati; etiamsi plane constaret Me in eorum servitutem assentientem posse in aliquam libertatem restituì, satius duco unum Regem vel de extremis periclitari, quàm tot in Eos Tyrannos confirmare: quod Deus avertat, quicquid de Me facturus est, qui Me in solitudine meâ solum esse nosse finit.

p.i: Tu enim (Domine) infinite Bonus & Magnus semper mecum es, cujus potior vita præsentia est, & cui servire Libertas consummatissima. Agnosce Me Famulum Tuum, nec jam querar amissam.

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Possible uncertainty: "pessundem" (printed as an ss-ligature form, read as pessundem; marked [?]). "conjunctaꝫ" uses the printed ꝫ ligature for -as. "Famulum" and the catchword "amissam" are read from the bottom line. The Greek running head is copied as printed. Show-through of mirrored text at the left edge is ignored.
